name: polarity-gpt-spl-benchmarking
description: Benchmark for evaluating GPT-style models on sentiment polarity classification and related polarity-sensitive language capabilities. It measures model accuracy and consistency when assigning polarity labels (e.g., positive/negative/neutral) across diverse text inputs and prompt variants. Useful for assessing robustness of generative LMs on basic sentiment understanding and calibration under paraphrases and prompting.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used for focused GPT polarity evaluations; modest community adoption compared with larger sentiment benchmarks.
